components.gap: owned by w02c-p15-011: Supply the source's stated reading of Theorem 3.3.21 (Durrett p. 136: 'The next result shows that the existence of second derivatives implies the existence of second moments'). The route only states and proves the symmetric-quotient form (limsup of Q(h) > -infinity iff E X^2 < infinity, body 382-401, annex 726-770) and the limit form for (phi(t)-1)/t^2.
